MOD = 998244353

def count_partitions(n, p):
    # Build the tree
    tree = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for i in range(1, n):
        tree[p[i]].append(i + 1)
    
    # Find all leaves
    leaves = [i for i in range(1, n + 1) if not tree[i]]
    
    # Calculate the number of ways to partition the leaves
    num_leaves = len(leaves)
    result = pow(2, num_leaves - 1, MOD)
    
    return result
